description:
Conduct a non-HTML content audit to identify PDF assets on https://crawler-test.com/. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
3. Filter the results to identify all PDF documents found on the site. (Hint: Use the 'Internal' tab filtered by 'PDF' or sort by Content Type).
4. Export the list of PDF URLs to a CSV file named 'pdf_inventory.csv' in '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/'. The CSV must contain the PDF URLs.
5. Create a summary text report at '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/pdf_audit_summary.txt' that includes the total count of PDF files found and a list of their filenames.

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- A CSV file exists at ~/Documents/SEO/exports/pdf_inventory.csv containing valid PDF URLs from crawler-test.com.
- A text report exists at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/pdf_audit_summary.txt with the count of PDFs found.
